title: David’s Mighty Men

questions.question: What are these words of David called in verse 1?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 23:1 (ESV): "Now these are the last words of David..."

questions.question: Who spoke by David?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 23:2 (ESV): "The Spirit of the LORD speaks by me; his word is on my tongue."

questions.question: Who was the chief of the three mighty men?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 23:8 (ESV): "...Josheb-basshebeth a Tahchemonite; he was chief of the three..."

questions.question: Who stood his ground in a plot of lentils and defeated the Philistines?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 23:11-12 (ESV): "...Shammah... took his stand in the midst of the plot and defended it..."

questions.question: What did the three mighty men bring David from Bethlehem?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 23:16 (ESV): "Then the three mighty men broke through... and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem..."

questions.question: Did David drink the water from Bethlehem?
options: No, he poured it out to the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: No, he poured it out to the Lord
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 23:16 (ESV): "He would not drink of it. He poured it out to the LORD."

questions.question: Who killed two ariels (lion-like men) of Moab and a lion in a pit?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 23:20 (ESV): "And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada... struck down two ariels of Moab. He also went down and struck down a lion in a pit..."

questions.question: Why did David refuse to drink the water?
options: Is it not the blood of the men who went at the risk of their lives?
questions.correctAnswer: Is it not the blood of the men who went at the risk of their lives?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 23:17 (ESV): "...Shall I drink the blood of the men who went at the risk of their lives?"

questions.question: Who was chief of the thirty, but not equal to the three?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 23:18-19 (ESV): "Now Abishai... was chief of the thirty... But he did not attain to the three."

questions.question: Who killed an Egyptian with the Egyptian's own spear?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 23:21 (ESV): "...he snatched the spear out of the Egyptian's hand and killed him with his own spear."

questions.question: How many men did Josheb-basshebeth kill at one time?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 23:8 (ESV): "...he wielded his spear against eight hundred whom he killed at one time."

questions.question: Who was with David when they defied the Philistines at Pas-dammim?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 23:9 (ESV): "And next to him was Eleazar the son of Dodo..."

questions.question: The God of Israel said, "When one rules justly over men, ruling in the fear of God, he dawns on them like the ______."
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 23:3-4 (ESV): "...he dawns on them like the morning light, like the sun shining forth..."

questions.question: Who is listed last in the list of the mighty men?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 23:39 (ESV): "Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in all."

questions.question: How many mighty men were there in total listed?

key_verse_text: For does not my house stand so with God? For he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things and secure. For will he not cause to prosper all my help and my desire? (ESV)
